name: qbeta-admissible-functional-hierarchy
description: Measures how many functionals are admissible under convention D (annihilating the (1^3) block) in three nested classes. All linear: 5 of 6 dimensions. Traces: 2 of 3. Markov traces: two points, z = q (which IS the augmentation) and z_D. The two Markov points SPAN the admissible trace space, so relaxing 'Markov trace' to 'trace' adds no new direction -- only the line through them, which is qou-99qc's one-parameter fit. The weight w* that hits Q_beta is the barycentric coordinate (1-z_D)/(q-z_D) of the inadmissible z=1 between the two roots, because Delta's support makes tr_M^z(Delta) affine in z -- the fit in closed form, not a derivation of it. Scope-(a); nothing wired.

assertions.name: the_1cubed_ideal_is_one_dimensional
assertions.detail: common (-1/q)-eigenspace of both generators has dim 1

assertions.name: class1_all_linear_functionals_admissible_dim
assertions.detail: dim = 5 of 6 (one condition: kill the ideal)

assertions.name: class2_trace_space_is_three_dimensional
assertions.detail: rank{chi_(3), chi_(2,1), chi_(1^3)} = 3 = the number of partitions of 3

assertions.name: class2_admissible_trace_space_is_TWO_dimensional
assertions.detail: rank{chi_(3), chi_(2,1)} = 2 (the (1^3) character is the one direction removed)

assertions.name: class2_chi_1cubed_does_NOT_annihilate_it
assertions.detail: chi_(1^3)(e_sign) = -q**3 - 2*q - 2/q - 1/q**3 -- the control: the removed direction is genuinely removed

assertions.name: class3_trM_at_z_equals_q_IS_the_augmentation
assertions.detail: tr_M^{z=q} == chi_(3) on all six basis elements (so the second root adds no third option)

assertions.name: class3_the_two_Markov_points_SPAN_the_admissible_trace_space
assertions.detail: rank{aug, tr_D} = 2, rank{aug, tr_D, chi_(3), chi_(2,1)} = 2 -- equal, so relaxing 'Markov trace' to 'trace' adds NO new direction, only the line through the two already named

assertions.name: control_net_is_outside_the_admissible_trace_space
assertions.detail: rank{aug, tr_D, net} = 3 > 2 (reproduces qou-99qc's rank-3 exclusion from a different construction)

assertions.name: trM_of_Delta_is_AFFINE_in_z
assertions.detail: tr_M^z(Delta) = q**2/2 - q*z - 1 + z/q + 1/(2*q**2) -- degree 1 in z, which is WHY one weight always exists

assertions.name: w_star_is_the_barycentric_coordinate_of_z_equals_1
assertions.detail: (1 - z_D)/(q - z_D) = -(q**3 - q**2 - 1)/q = qou-99qc's w*. So w* is where z=1 sits between the two admissible roots -- a restatement of one-equation-one-unknown, not a derivation

assertions.name: w_star_carries_the_supergolden_polynomial
assertions.detail: w* = -(q^3 - q^2 - 1)/q. The same factor appears in N(q,1) = (q - 1)*(q**3 - q**2 - 1), because both measure how far z=1 is from being a root -- shared cause, not independent evidence

admissible_dimensions.markov_traces: 2 points (z = q, z_D); z = q IS the augmentation

w_star.status: the fit in closed form; NOT derived

caveats: Does NOT widen the honest options. The extra admissible traces are exactly the line through the two already named.
Dropping the trace condition does add directions (5 of 6), but a non-trace functional is not a Markov trace and loses the link to knot invariants that motivates the construction.
Says nothing about which functional SHOULD be used -- qou-99qc's owner call is untouched.
Delta_S only; qou-avt5's finding that Delta_S is not the exhibited nucleon-word difference is unaffected.
q0AnchorReason: Display only. Every dimension and every identity is exact over Q(q) and pin-free; q0 enters solely to print w*(q0).
